dct_creator_sm: McFaul, Emily (Department of Plant Agriculture. Ontario Agricultural College. University of Guelph.).
dct_description_sm: As part of the "Management of Stemphylium leaf blight" thesis research, average disease ratings, severity and incidence of leaf blight on onion foliage in field and destructive ratings at the end of season for both 2022 and 2023 field seasons were assessed to evaluate fungicide efficacy. Additional evaluations for yield, weight and grade of onion bulbs were also included.
dct_title_s: Supplemental data for: Management of Stemphylium leaf blight: Fungicide efficacy evaluations
